en: For the conductor, on the gittit, a song of Dovid:

he: יְהֹוָ֤ה אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מָה־אַדִּ֣יר שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכׇל־הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּנָ֥ה ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ עַל־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
en: Havayah, our Master, how mighty is Your name in all the earth, Who has set Your glory above the heavens.

he: מִפִּ֤י עוֹלְלִ֨ים ׀ וְֽיֹנְקִים֮ יִסַּ֢דְתָּ֫ עֹ֥ז לְמַ֥עַן צוֹרְרֶ֑יךָ לְהַשְׁבִּ֥ית א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃
en: From the mouth of babes and sucklings You have founded strength, because of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and the avenger.

he: כִּֽי־אֶרְאֶ֣ה שָׁ֭מֶיךָ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ יָרֵ֥חַ וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר כּוֹנָֽנְתָּה׃
en: When I see Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars that You established:
What is man, that You remember him, and the son of man, that You take account of him?

he: וַתְּחַסְּרֵ֣הוּ מְּ֭עַט מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכָב֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽהוּ׃
en: And You have made him lack little from Elokim, and with glory and splendor You crown him.

he: תַּ֭מְשִׁילֵהוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָדֶ֑יךָ כֹּ֝֗ל שַׁ֣תָּה תַֽחַת־רַגְלָֽיו׃
en: You give him dominion over the works of Your hands; all You have placed beneath his feet:

he: צֹנֶ֣ה וַאֲלָפִ֣ים כֻּלָּ֑ם וְ֝גַ֗ם בַּהֲמ֥וֹת שָׂדָֽי׃
en: Flocks and cattle, all of them, and also the beasts of the field;

he: צִפּ֣וֹר שָׁ֭מַיִם וּדְגֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם עֹ֝בֵ֗ר אׇרְח֥וֹת יַמִּֽים׃
en: the bird of the heavens and the fish of the sea, passing through the paths of the seas.
Havayah, our Master, how mighty is Your name in all the earth! [an open section break]
